senses.zh: 公开活动；发生 的事情

senses.en: Something that happens, especially an important or planned occasion.
A particular contest within a sports competition.

ex.en: The outdoor concert was our town's biggest summer event.
ex.zh: 这场户外音乐会是我们镇上夏季最大的活动。

ex.en: Hosting a major cultural event can boost local tourism, although the financial benefits may be unevenly distributed.
ex.zh: 举办大型文化活动可以促进当地旅游业，但经济收益的分配可能不均。

col: in the event of｜万一发生
tip: in the event of后接名词，意为“万一发生”。

senses.en: a large open area in a town or city with buildings around it

ex.en: Many families take a walk in the city square after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后许多家庭会在城市广场散步。

ex.en: Tian'anmen Square in Beijing is a famous open place where visitors watch the flag rise.
ex.zh: 北京的天安门广场是一个著名的开阔场所，游客们在那里看升旗。

tip: 注意区别：作地点名词指“广场”，专有名词作广场名时首字母大写。

senses.en: a long orchestral composition, usually divided into several movements

ex.en: We listened to a symphony while cooking dinner.
ex.zh: 我们做晚饭时听了一首交响曲。

ex.en: Performing a symphony requires close cooperation among musicians, demonstrating the importance of teamwork in the arts.
ex.zh: 演奏交响曲需要音乐家之间密切合作，体现了团队协作在艺术中的重要性。

tip: symphony指交响曲；交响乐团用symphony orchestra。

senses.en: A building where people watch plays and other live performances.
The activity or art of writing, producing, and performing plays.
A specially equipped room in a hospital where operations happen.

ex.en: We arrived at the theatre just before the play started.
ex.zh: 我们在话剧开演前刚好赶到了剧院。

ex.en: Public funding for theatre can make live performances accessible to audiences who cannot afford expensive tickets.
ex.zh: 对戏剧的公共资助能让买不起高价门票的观众也有机会观看现场演出。

col: go to the theatre｜去剧院看戏
tip: 英式拼写theatre，美式常写theater；英式电影院用cinema。

senses.en: an object that burns or explodes with bright colours outdoors

ex.en: A single firework burst above the lake, scattering golden sparks.
ex.zh: 一枚烟花在湖面上空绽放，洒下金色火花。

ex.en: Public firework displays can attract visitors, although their noise may disturb local residents and wildlife.
ex.zh: 公共焰火表演可以吸引游客，但其噪声可能打扰当地居民和野生动物。

tip: 单枚烟花可数；泛指烟花或焰火表演常用fireworks。

senses.en: a live musical performance given before an audience

ex.en: We enjoyed an outdoor concert in the park yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在公园欣赏了一场露天音乐会。

ex.en: Free public concerts can make cultural activities more accessible and encourage residents to use shared urban spaces.
ex.zh: 免费公共音乐会能让更多人参与文化活动，并鼓励居民使用城市公共空间。

tip: 去听音乐会用 go to a concert。

senses.en: A male royal family member, often a monarch's son.
A male ruler of a small independent state.

ex.en: The prince waved to visitors from the palace balcony.
ex.zh: 王子在宫殿阳台上向来访者挥手。

ex.en: In some constitutional monarchies, a prince may support charitable organisations without holding any direct political power.
ex.zh: 在一些君主立宪制国家，王子可能支持慈善组织，但不掌握任何直接的政治权力。

tip: prince不一定是王子，也可指亲王或公国君主。

senses.en: to look at something carefully to make sure it is right or safe

ex.en: Always check your homework before you put it into your bag.
ex.zh: 把作业放进书包前一定要检查一遍。

ex.en: Scientists check the weather data every hour to keep people safe during heavy storms.
ex.zh: 科学家每小时核查天气数据，以保护人们在暴风雨中的安全。

tip: 表示“检查、核实”时直接接宾语，过去式直接加ed变为checked。

senses.zh: 察看，观察（有趣或 有吸引力的人或事物）
senses.en: to look at something interesting or exciting to see what it is like

ex.en: Come and check out this cool model plane I made!
ex.zh: 快来看看我做的这架酷炫飞机模型！

ex.en: Visitors can check out the amazing robot show at the Shenzhen Science Museum this Saturday.
ex.zh: 本周六游客们可以去深圳科学馆参观精彩的机器人展。

col: check out this book｜看看这本书
check out the show｜观看展览
tip: 常用于口语邀请别人“快来看看有趣的事物”，如Check it out!

senses.zh: 信息；消息；情报；资料；资讯

senses.en: Facts or details about someone or something

ex.en: The receptionist gave us useful information about local buses.
ex.zh: 接待员向我们提供了有关当地公交车的实用信息。

ex.en: Access to reliable information enables patients to make better decisions about their treatment and long-term health.
ex.zh: 获取可靠信息能帮助患者就治疗和长期健康作出更好的决定。

col: access to information｜信息获取渠道
a piece of information｜一条信息
tip: 不可数：说some information，不说an information。

senses.en: from a past time until a later time, usually now
from when something happened; because something is true
at a time or throughout the period after that

ex.en: I have lived in this neighbourhood since childhood.
ex.zh: 我从小就住在这个街区。

ex.en: Since public transport reduces traffic congestion, governments should invest in more reliable bus services.
ex.zh: 由于公共交通能够缓解交通拥堵，政府应投资建设更可靠的公交服务。

tip: 表时间时，since接起点，for接时长。

senses.en: the act of singing, dancing, or acting on a stage for an audience

ex.en: The children gave a wonderful music performance at the school hall.
ex.zh: 孩子们在学校礼堂献上了一场精彩的音乐表演。

ex.en: Before the New Year dance performance, all the young dancers practiced on stage every afternoon.
ex.zh: 新年舞蹈表演前，所有小舞者每天下午都在舞台上练习。

tip: 由动词perform加名词后缀-ance构成，指舞台上的文艺演出。

senses.en: Used to make an adjective, adverb, or statement stronger.
In fact, rather than only apparently or supposedly.
Used in questions to express surprise or doubt.

ex.en: This soup is really hot, so let it cool.
ex.zh: 这汤非常烫，先让它凉一凉吧。

ex.en: Before expanding online education, policymakers should consider whether digital courses really meet the needs of disadvantaged learners.
ex.zh: 在扩大在线教育之前，政策制定者应考虑数字课程是否真正满足弱势学习者的需求。

tip: not really通常表示“不太”，语气比直接说no缓和。

senses.en: Relating to music, or showing skill and interest in it.
A play or film whose story includes songs and dancing.
Having a pleasant sound resembling music.

ex.en: He keeps his musical instruments beside the sofa.
ex.zh: 他把乐器放在沙发旁边。

ex.en: Schools that offer musical training give children valuable opportunities to develop creativity and practise teamwork.
ex.zh: 提供音乐训练的学校为孩子们培养创造力和练习团队合作提供了宝贵机会。

tip: 作形容词指“音乐的”；作可数名词指音乐剧等。

senses.en: to entertain an audience by acting, singing, or playing music
to carry out a task, action, or duty
to work or achieve results in a particular way

ex.en: Our choir will perform at the community centre tonight.
ex.zh: 我们的合唱团今晚将在社区中心演出。

ex.en: Students often perform better academically when schools provide regular feedback and access to individual support.
ex.zh: 学校提供定期反馈和个别支持时，学生的学业表现往往更好。

tip: 既可指表演，也可接task、duty表示执行。

senses.en: to ask someone to attend something or do something
to request a response or make a reaction likely

ex.en: Let's invite our new neighbours over for dinner.
ex.zh: 我们邀请新邻居过来吃晚饭吧。

ex.en: Local councils should invite residents to discuss proposed changes before making decisions about public spaces.
ex.zh: 地方议会在就公共空间作出决定前，应邀请居民讨论拟议的改动。

col: invite someone to dinner｜邀请某人吃晚饭
invite someone to do something｜邀请某人做某事
tip: invite sb to＋活动；invite sb to do＋动作。

senses.en: To mark a special occasion by doing something enjoyable.
To praise someone or something publicly.

ex.en: We cooked a special dinner to celebrate her graduation.
ex.zh: 我们做了一顿特别的晚餐来庆祝她毕业。

ex.en: Community festivals celebrate local traditions while giving residents opportunities to strengthen relationships with their neighbours.
ex.zh: 社区节庆活动在弘扬当地传统的同时，也让居民有机会增进邻里关系。

col: celebrate an achievement｜庆祝一项成就
tip: 庆祝某事用celebrate；祝贺某人用congratulate。

senses.en: A chart of dates or a schedule of events.
A system for dividing time into years, months, and days.

ex.en: I marked our camping weekend on the kitchen calendar.
ex.zh: 我在厨房的日历上标出了周末露营的日子。

ex.en: Schools should publish an annual calendar so families can plan holidays around important educational events.
ex.zh: 学校应公布年度日程表，方便家庭避开重要教学活动来安排假期。

tip: calendar year指一月至十二月，不等于学年。

senses.en: a traditional calendar based on the cycles of the moon

ex.en: My grandparents always check the lunar calendar for traditional festivals.
ex.zh: 爷爷奶奶总是查看农历来了解传统节日。

ex.en: According to the Chinese lunar calendar, the Mid-Autumn Festival brings families together under the full moon.
ex.zh: 根据中国农历，中秋节让家人们在满月下团聚。

col: follow the lunar calendar｜遵循农历
tip: lunar意为“月亮的”，中国传统节日多按lunar calendar推算。

senses.en: An occasion when people meet again after time apart.

ex.en: Our family reunion filled the garden with laughter.
ex.zh: 我们的家庭聚会让花园里充满了欢笑。

ex.en: School reunions can strengthen social connections and encourage former students to support their local communities.
ex.zh: 校友聚会能够加强社会联系，并鼓励往届学生支持当地社区。

tip: 强调分别后的再相聚，不泛指任何聚会。

senses.en: Containing as much as possible, with no space left.
Including everything, with nothing missing.
Having eaten enough and not wanting more food.

ex.en: The basket is full, so we need another one.
ex.zh: 篮子已经满了，我们得再拿一个。

ex.en: Governments should publish the full results of environmental studies so that citizens can make informed decisions.
ex.zh: 政府应公布环境研究的完整结果，以便公民作出知情决策。

tip: full of表示“充满”；注意full与fool发音不同。

senses.en: Letters and parcels, or the system used to deliver them.
To send something by mail or share it publicly.
A job or position in an organisation.

ex.en: A parcel arrived in the post this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上寄来了一个包裹。

ex.en: Local authorities should post regular updates online to keep residents informed about changes to public services.
ex.zh: 地方政府应定期在网上发布最新消息，让居民了解公共服务的变化。

col: apply for a post｜申请职位
tip: 邮寄义中，英式常用post，美式常用mail。

senses.en: mainly, or for the largest part

ex.en: My weekend was mostly spent cooking and reading.
ex.zh: 我的周末大部分时间都用来做饭和看书了。

ex.en: In many rural areas, residents rely mostly on private vehicles because public transport services are limited.
ex.zh: 在许多农村地区，由于公共交通服务有限，居民主要依靠私家车出行。

tip: mostly指大部分情况；almost指差一点或几乎。

senses.en: during the evening or night of today
the evening or night of today

ex.en: We are making vegetable soup for dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 我们今晚要做蔬菜汤当晚餐。

ex.en: Residents will meet tonight to discuss how public transport could better serve the local community.
ex.zh: 居民们今晚将开会讨论公共交通如何更好地服务当地社区。

tip: 作时间状语时直接用tonight，前面不加介词。

senses.en: the gathering of crops, or the crops gathered
to gather crops when they are ready

ex.en: We celebrated the apple harvest with a homemade pie.
ex.zh: 我们做了一个自制苹果派，庆祝苹果丰收。

ex.en: Unpredictable rainfall can reduce the annual harvest, threatening rural incomes and increasing food prices in cities.
ex.zh: 难以预测的降雨可能减少年度收成，威胁农村收入并推高城市食品价格。

tip: 作名词可指收割活动，也可指收获的作物或产量。

senses.en: Following customs or methods passed down over a long time.

ex.en: We cooked a traditional meal for the family gathering.
ex.zh: 我们为家庭聚会做了一顿传统饭菜。

ex.en: Traditional farming methods can preserve local knowledge, although some require adaptation to cope with climate change.
ex.zh: 传统耕作方法能够保留地方知识，但其中一些需要调整以应对气候变化。

tip: traditional强调传承已久，不一定表示落后。

senses.en: A hard-shelled fruit with an edible seed inside.
A small metal piece screwed onto a bolt to fasten things.

ex.en: She cracked a nut and shared the kernel with me.
ex.zh: 她敲开一颗坚果，把果仁分给我吃。

ex.en: Nuts provide useful nutrients, although schools must consider food allergies when planning meals for children.
ex.zh: 坚果能提供有益的营养物质，但学校为儿童安排餐食时必须考虑食物过敏问题。

col: nuts and bolts｜螺母和螺栓；基本细节
tip: 食物和五金中的nut都是可数名词。

senses.en: A sweet substance used to make food and drinks sweeter

ex.en: She stirred a spoonful of sugar into her tea.
ex.zh: 她往茶里加了一勺糖，搅拌均匀。

ex.en: Reducing sugar consumption can help prevent health problems associated with an unhealthy diet.
ex.zh: 减少糖的摄入有助于预防与不健康饮食有关的健康问题。

tip: 泛指食糖时通常不可数；a spoonful of sugar指一勺糖。

senses.en: knowledge or skill gained by doing things
something that happens to you or that you do
to have something happen to you or feel something

ex.en: My sister has years of experience repairing old bicycles.
ex.zh: 我姐姐有多年修理旧自行车的经验。

ex.en: Work experience can help graduates develop practical skills that employers value alongside academic qualifications.
ex.zh: 工作经验能帮助毕业生培养实践技能，而雇主不仅重视学历，也看重这些技能。

col: a rewarding experience｜有收获的经历
tip: 表“经验”不可数；表具体“经历”可数。

senses.en: An occasion when you eat, or the food eaten then.

ex.en: Dad cooked a warm meal after our long walk.
ex.zh: 我们长途步行回来后，爸爸做了一顿热乎乎的饭。

ex.en: Providing healthy school meals can improve children's concentration and support their physical development.
ex.zh: 提供健康的学校餐食能提高儿童的专注力，并促进他们的身体发育。

tip: meal指一顿饭；food泛指食物，通常不可数。

senses.en: to find how many things there are
to matter or have an important effect
the act of counting, or the total found

ex.en: Please count the plates before our guests arrive.
ex.zh: 请在客人到来之前数一下盘子。

ex.en: When evaluating educational success, students' confidence and creativity should count as much as examination results.
ex.zh: 评估教育成效时，学生的自信和创造力应与考试成绩同样重要。

col: lose count｜数不清；忘记数到哪里
every minute counts｜每分钟都很重要
tip: count on意为依靠；count作“重要”时不及物。

senses.en: to look carefully for information, a person, or a missing thing

ex.en: I use the computer to search for facts about giant pandas.
ex.zh: 我用电脑搜索关于大熊猫的资料。

ex.en: Students can search the school library database to find books about space and planet science.
ex.zh: 学生可以在学校图书馆数据库里查找关于太空和行星科学的书籍。

tip: 表示“搜寻某物”时常搭配介词for，即search for something。

senses.en: A place where planes take off, land, and collect passengers

ex.en: We arrived at the airport before the sun rose.
ex.zh: 太阳还没升起，我们就到了机场。

ex.en: Expanding an airport may boost tourism, but it can also increase noise pollution for nearby residents.
ex.zh: 扩建机场可能促进旅游业，但也可能加重附近居民受到的噪声污染。

tip: 在机场通常用at the airport；航站楼是terminal。

senses.en: The place where something is or where something happens.
A place outside a studio where filming takes place.

ex.en: This cafe has a lovely location beside the river.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆坐落在河边，位置很不错。

ex.en: The location of affordable housing strongly influences residents' access to schools, healthcare, and employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 保障性住房的位置会显著影响居民获得教育、医疗服务和就业机会的便利程度。

tip: on location指在摄影棚外实地拍摄。

senses.en: the city where a country or region's government is based
money or assets used to start or operate a business
a letter in its large form

ex.en: We visited the capital and explored its busy markets.
ex.zh: 我们游览了首都，逛了那里热闹的市场。

ex.en: Small businesses often struggle to obtain enough capital to invest in new equipment and staff training.
ex.zh: 小企业往往难以筹集足够资金，用于购置新设备和培训员工。

tip: 表示资金时通常不可数；表示大写字母时可数。

senses.en: Covered with or containing water or another liquid
Having rain or frequent rainfall
To put water or another liquid onto something

ex.en: My socks got wet when I stepped in a puddle.
ex.zh: 我踩进水坑，把袜子弄湿了。

ex.en: Prolonged wet weather can damage crops and make it harder for farmers to harvest them efficiently.
ex.zh: 持续的阴雨天气会损害庄稼，使农民更难高效收获。

tip: damp指微湿；soaking wet表示湿透。

senses.en: filled with fog, making things difficult to see
unclear or difficult to remember or understand

ex.en: The road was so foggy that we drove slowly.
ex.zh: 路上雾很大，我们只好慢慢开车。

ex.en: Foggy conditions can disrupt air travel, causing delays that affect both passengers and airport operations.
ex.zh: 大雾天气可能扰乱航空出行，造成延误，影响乘客和机场运营。

col: a foggy morning｜雾蒙蒙的早晨
tip: foggy既可形容天气，也可形容记忆模糊。

senses.en: the direction opposite south, or an area's northern part
in the north or facing towards it
towards or in the north

ex.en: The north of the island gets snow every winter.
ex.zh: 这座岛的北部每年冬天都会下雪。

ex.en: Investment in rail connections could help towns in the north attract businesses and create more local jobs.
ex.zh: 投资铁路连接设施可以帮助北部城镇吸引企业，并创造更多本地就业岗位。

tip: in the north of指在内部北部；north of指在其以北。

senses.en: To a fairly large degree, but not extremely.
Completely or to the greatest possible degree.

ex.en: The soup is quite spicy, but I like it.
ex.zh: 这汤挺辣的，不过我喜欢。

ex.en: Although cycling is quite popular among students, inadequate infrastructure prevents many commuters from choosing this sustainable option.
ex.zh: 虽然骑行在学生中颇受欢迎，但基础设施不足使许多通勤者无法选择这种可持续的出行方式。

tip: quite good常指相当好；quite impossible指完全不可能。

senses.en: A measure of how hot or cold something is.
A body temperature higher than normal because of illness.

ex.en: The temperature dropped sharply after the sun went down.
ex.zh: 太阳落山后，气温急剧下降。

ex.en: Rising ocean temperatures can damage coral reefs and threaten the survival of many marine species.
ex.zh: 海洋温度上升会破坏珊瑚礁，并威胁许多海洋物种的生存。

col: take someone's temperature｜测量某人的体温
tip: have a temperature通常指发烧，不只是有体温。

senses.en: to become lower in number, level, or temperature

ex.en: The temperature will drop quickly after the sun goes down.
ex.zh: 太阳落山后，气温会很快下降。

ex.en: In winter, the temperature can drop below zero degrees in many northern cities of China.
ex.zh: 冬天，中国许多北方城市的气温会降到零度以下。

col: drop below zero｜降到零度以下
tip: 表温度或数量“下降”，过去式dropped和-ing形式要双写p。

senses.en: a unit used to measure temperature or angles

ex.en: It is thirty degrees outside today, so wear a cool T-shirt.
ex.zh: 今天外面有三十度，所以穿件凉爽的T恤吧。

ex.en: Water freezes into ice at zero degrees Celsius and boils at one hundred degrees Celsius.
ex.zh: 水在零摄氏度会结成冰，在一百摄氏度会沸腾。

col: rise by two degrees｜升高两度
tip: 表示“几度”且数字大于1时要用复数degrees，如ten degrees。

senses.en: relating to the temperature scale where water freezes at 0 and boils at 100

ex.en: The weather report says it is twenty-five degrees Celsius today.
ex.zh: 天气预报说今天是二十五摄氏度。

ex.en: In science class, we use a thermometer to measure warm water in degrees Celsius.
ex.zh: 在科学课上，我们用温度计以摄氏度来测量温水的温度。

tip: Celsius是人名演变来的词，任何时候首字母C都必须大写，简写为℃。

senses.en: not wet or containing very little moisture
to remove moisture or become free from moisture
not interesting or entertaining

ex.en: The towels are dry after hanging in the sunshine.
ex.zh: 毛巾在阳光下晾过后已经干了。

ex.en: Long periods of dry weather can damage crops and threaten food security in agricultural communities.
ex.zh: 长期干旱天气会损害农作物，并威胁农业社区的粮食安全。

tip: 形容词比较级drier；名词dryer指烘干设备。

senses.en: the direction opposite north
in, towards, or facing the south
towards or in the south

ex.en: Our balcony faces south and gets plenty of sunshine.
ex.zh: 我们的阳台朝南，阳光很充足。

ex.en: Many families move to the south because its warmer climate allows more outdoor activities throughout the year.
ex.zh: 许多家庭搬到南方，因为那里气候更温暖，全年都能进行更多户外活动。

tip: 南部用in the south；向南用go south，不加to。

senses.en: Continuing up to a particular time without stopping or changing.
Not moving.
Despite what has just been said.

ex.en: It is nearly midnight, but my sister is still awake.
ex.zh: 快到午夜了，可我姐姐还醒着。

ex.en: Despite improvements in public transport, many commuters still rely on private cars because services remain unreliable in rural areas.
ex.zh: 尽管公共交通有所改善，许多通勤者仍依赖私家车，因为农村地区的公共交通服务依然不可靠。

tip: 表“仍然”时，通常放实义动词前、be动词后。

senses.en: Air moving naturally outdoors.
To wrap something around an object or itself.
To follow a route with many bends and turns.

ex.en: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat away.
ex.zh: 突然一阵风把我的帽子吹走了。

ex.en: Investing in wind power can help countries reduce their dependence on fossil fuels and lower carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 投资风能可以帮助各国减少对化石燃料的依赖，并降低碳排放。

tip: 风读/wɪnd/；缠绕读/waɪnd/，过去式wound。

senses.en: a visible mass of tiny water drops in the sky
a mass of smoke, dust, or similar material in air
to make thoughts or judgment less clear

ex.en: A dark cloud drifted slowly across the afternoon sky.
ex.zh: 一朵乌云缓缓飘过午后的天空。

ex.en: Strong emotions can cloud public judgment when communities debate the benefits and risks of new technologies.
ex.zh: 当社区讨论新技术的利弊时，强烈的情绪可能影响公众的判断。

col: a cloud of dust｜一团尘土
cloud someone's judgment｜影响某人的判断
tip: cloud作动词可指使判断不清，如cloud your judgment。

senses.en: a thick cloud near the ground that limits visibility
to become or make a surface covered with fine droplets

ex.en: Thick fog hid the hills behind our house.
ex.zh: 浓雾遮住了我们屋后的山丘。

ex.en: Dense fog can disrupt transport networks, causing flight cancellations and increasing the risk of road accidents.
ex.zh: 浓雾可能扰乱交通网络，导致航班取消，并增加道路事故的风险。

tip: fog比mist更浓；fog up常指玻璃蒙上雾气。

senses.en: to move over ice or ground wearing special wheeled or bladed shoes
a boot with a blade or wheels for moving smoothly

ex.en: We skate around the rink every Saturday afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们每周六下午都在溜冰场滑冰。

ex.en: Public facilities where children can skate safely encourage physical activity and provide affordable recreation for families.
ex.zh: 供儿童安全滑冰的公共设施能鼓励体育活动，并为家庭提供经济实惠的娱乐选择。

col: a pair of skates｜一双溜冰鞋
tip: 鞋子常用复数skates；go skating表示去滑冰。

senses.en: a meal eaten outdoors, usually with food brought from home
to eat a meal outdoors for pleasure

ex.en: We had a picnic under a shady tree.
ex.zh: 我们在一棵树的荫凉下野餐。

ex.en: Public parks provide affordable spaces where families can enjoy picnics and spend quality time together.
ex.zh: 公共公园提供了花费不高的空间，让家庭享受野餐并共度美好时光。

tip: 动词过去式为picnicked，进行形式为picnicking。

senses.en: light and warmth coming from the sun

senses.zh: 欢乐；带来快乐的人或事
senses.en: happiness, or someone or something that brings happiness

ex.en: We ate our breakfast outside in the warm sunshine.
ex.zh: 我们在外面温暖的阳光下吃了早餐。

ex.en: Access to parks and sunshine can improve residents' wellbeing, especially in densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 能够享用公园和阳光可以改善居民的身心健康，在人口密集的城市地区尤其如此。

col: a ray of sunshine｜带来快乐的人或事
tip: sunshine通常不可数；表示晴天可说a sunny day。

senses.en: To dislike someone or something very strongly.
A very strong feeling of dislike towards someone or something.

ex.en: I hate finding wet socks on the bathroom floor.
ex.zh: 我特别讨厌在浴室地板上发现湿袜子。

ex.en: Although many commuters hate crowded trains, affordable public transport remains essential for reducing urban traffic.
ex.zh: 虽然许多通勤者讨厌拥挤的列车，但价格实惠的公共交通对于缓解城市交通拥堵仍然至关重要。

tip: hate后可接动名词或不定式，语气比dislike强。

senses.en: very great in degree or far beyond what is usual
far beyond what most people consider reasonable or acceptable
either end of a range of conditions or behaviour

ex.en: We kept the curtains closed during the extreme heat.
ex.zh: 酷热期间，我们一直拉着窗帘。

ex.en: Extreme weather events can damage infrastructure and place considerable pressure on emergency services in vulnerable communities.
ex.zh: 极端天气事件会破坏基础设施，并给脆弱社区的应急服务带来巨大压力。

tip: 副词用extremely；名词常见go to extremes。

senses.zh: 媒体对重要事情的报道；新闻

senses.en: information about recent events or something previously unknown
a broadcast or report presenting recent events

ex.en: She called her sister to share the good news.
ex.zh: 她给姐姐打电话，分享这个好消息。

ex.en: People should check several reliable sources before sharing news about health issues on social media.
ex.zh: 人们在社交媒体上分享健康问题的新闻前，应核实多个可靠来源。

col: a piece of news｜一条消息
tip: news不可数且接单数谓语：The news is good。

senses.en: warmth or a high temperature
to make or become warmer
a race that decides who enters the next round

ex.en: We rested under a tree to escape the heat.
ex.zh: 我们在树下休息，躲避酷热。

ex.en: Cities can reduce extreme heat by planting trees and replacing dark surfaces with materials that reflect sunlight.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过植树以及用反射阳光的材料替换深色表面来缓解酷热。

tip: heat作名词指热，hot作形容词指热的。

senses.en: A moving ridge of water or a travelling energy disturbance.
To move a hand or object repeatedly as a signal.
A sudden increase or spread of something.

ex.en: A huge wave washed over our little sandcastle.
ex.zh: 一个大浪冲过了我们的小沙堡。

ex.en: Coastal wetlands can absorb wave energy, helping to protect nearby settlements from erosion and storm damage.
ex.zh: 沿海湿地能够吸收波浪能量，帮助保护附近居民区免受侵蚀和风暴破坏。

col: a wave of protests｜一波抗议
tip: 向某人挥手用wave at或wave to someone。

senses.en: a period of unusually hot weather lasting for several days

ex.en: Drink plenty of water when a summer heatwave arrives here.
ex.zh: 夏天热浪来临时，要多喝水。

ex.en: During a strong heatwave, schools advise students to stay indoors and avoid heavy outdoor sports.
ex.zh: 在强热浪期间，学校建议学生待在室内，避免剧烈户外运动。

tip: 由heat（热）和wave（波浪）合成，表示持续多日的酷热天气。

senses.en: to reach a particular level, number, or amount

ex.en: The afternoon heat can hit thirty-eight degrees in August.
ex.zh: 八月午后的气温能达到三十八度。

ex.en: During the summer holiday, the number of visitors to the park hit a new high.
ex.zh: 暑假期间，这个公园的游客数量达到了新高。

tip: 这里表示数值或温度“达到”，过去式也是hit，注意和“击打”区分。

senses.en: More than two but not many
A few people or things already mentioned or understood

ex.en: I tried several jackets before choosing the blue one.
ex.zh: 我试了几件夹克后，选中了蓝色的那件。

ex.en: Several studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among people living in cities.
ex.zh: 几项研究表明，能够接触绿地可能改善城市居民的心理健康。

col: several of them｜他们中的几个
for several reasons｜出于几个原因
tip: 后接可数名词复数；several of后接限定词或代词。

senses.en: To separate into pieces or damage something so it stops working.
A short period when an activity stops.
To fail to obey a rule or keep a promise.

ex.en: Be careful not to break that glass bowl.
ex.zh: 小心别打碎那个玻璃碗。

ex.en: Regular breaks during study sessions may improve concentration and help students retain new information.
ex.zh: 学习期间定时休息可能有助于提高注意力，并帮助学生记住新知识。

tip: 动词变化为break—broke—broken；休息用take a break。

senses.en: Stored information about events, activities, or a person's history.
To store information, sounds, or images for future use.
The best result ever achieved in a particular activity.

ex.en: I keep a record of everything I spend.
ex.zh: 我把每一笔花费都记下来。

ex.en: Accurate medical records allow healthcare professionals to make informed decisions and avoid unnecessary treatments.
ex.zh: 准确的医疗记录让医护人员能够作出有依据的决定，避免不必要的治疗。

tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: to increase to or arrive at a particular number or level

ex.en: The water temperature will reach one hundred degrees very soon.
ex.zh: 水温很快就会达到一百度。

ex.en: By noon, the summer temperature in the city can reach thirty-five degrees Celsius or higher.
ex.zh: 到了中午，这座城市的夏季气温能达到三十五摄氏度甚至更高。

tip: reach是及物动词，表示“达到某数值”时直接接数字或水平，不加to。

senses.en: to start suddenly, such as a fire, storm, or cheering

ex.en: Loud cheers break out when our team wins the match.
ex.zh: 我们队赢得比赛时，响亮的欢呼声爆发出来。

ex.en: Dry leaves in autumn can cause a forest fire to break out if people are careless.
ex.zh: 秋天干燥的树叶如果遇到人们粗心大意，就可能引发森林火灾突然爆发。

col: a fire breaks out｜发生火灾
a storm breaks out｜暴风雨突然来临
tip: break out主动表爆发，主语常是火灾或欢呼声，过去式broke。

senses.zh: （地方、城市、 国家、世界的）地区，地域

senses.en: A particular part of a place or geographical region
The amount of surface that something covers
A particular subject or part of an activity

ex.en: There is a quiet picnic area beside the lake.
ex.zh: 湖边有一处安静的野餐区。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can improve access to employment for people living in rural areas.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以让农村居民更容易获得就业机会。

col: an area of research｜研究领域
tip: 表示面积时常用平方米等单位；也可指研究领域。

senses.en: a long, flat road at an airport where planes take off and land

ex.en: We watched the big plane land safely on the runway.
ex.zh: 我们看着那架大飞机安全地降落在跑道上。

ex.en: Bright lights along the airport runway guide pilots when planes take off at night.
ex.zh: 飞机夜间起飞时，机场跑道两旁明亮的灯光会指引飞行员。

tip: 由run和way合成，“在飞机跑道上”介词常用on，即on the runway。

senses.en: Something done to achieve a result or address a problem.
A particular thing that someone does.
Exciting events in a story, film, or real situation.

ex.en: We need to take action before the leak worsens.
ex.zh: 我们得在漏水加重之前采取行动。

ex.en: Governments must take urgent action to protect coastal communities from the growing risks of climate change.
ex.zh: 政府必须紧急采取行动，保护沿海社区免受日益加剧的气候变化风险影响。

tip: take action中的action不可数；具体举动可用actions。

senses.en: A child who attends school.
The dark opening in the eye that lets light enter.

ex.en: Each pupil brought a leaf to the science lesson.
ex.zh: 每个学生都带了一片树叶来上科学课。

ex.en: Smaller classes may allow teachers to give each pupil more individual support and useful feedback.
ex.zh: 小班教学可能让教师为每个学生提供更多个别指导和有用的反馈。

tip: 英式英语常指中小学生；大学生用 student。

senses.en: Special clothing worn by members of a particular group.
Remaining the same in form, quality, or amount.

ex.en: My school uniform is still drying by the window.
ex.zh: 我的校服还在窗边晾着。

ex.en: Uniform safety standards across all factories can help protect workers and improve overall working conditions.
ex.zh: 所有工厂实行统一的安全标准，有助于保护工人并改善整体工作条件。

tip: 开头是辅音/j/，所以说a uniform，不用an。

senses.en: Inside a building, or into a building.

ex.en: We stayed indoors and played chess during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨期间，我们待在室内下棋。

ex.en: Children who spend most of their time indoors may have fewer opportunities for physical activity.
ex.zh: 大部分时间待在室内的孩子可能较少有机会进行体育活动。

col: keep pets indoors｜把宠物养在室内
tip: indoors是副词；修饰名词用indoor，如indoor sports。

senses.en: a flat green part that grows from a plant stem or tree branch

ex.en: A small green leaf falls softly onto my desk near the window.
ex.zh: 一片绿色的小叶子轻轻落在靠近窗户的书桌上。

ex.en: Every green leaf on a tree uses sunlight and air to make food.
ex.zh: 树上的每一片绿叶都能利用阳光和空气来制造养分。

tip: leaf的复数要把f变为ves，即leaves，不要直接加s哦。

senses.en: Something known or proved to be true.

ex.en: We checked the facts before booking our train tickets.
ex.zh: 我们核实了相关情况后才订火车票。

ex.en: Students should learn to distinguish facts from opinions when evaluating information shared through digital media.
ex.zh: 学生在评估数字媒体传播的信息时，应学会区分事实和观点。

tip: the fact that后接完整从句，说明事实内容。

senses.en: used to introduce what is really true, especially when surprising

ex.en: He looks quiet, but in fact he loves telling jokes.
ex.zh: 他看起来很安静，但事实上他很喜欢讲笑话。

ex.en: Dolphins live in the ocean, yet in fact they are mammals rather than fish.
ex.zh: 海豚生活在海洋里，但事实上它们是哺乳动物而不是鱼。

col: in fact, it is｜事实上它是
tip: 常放在句首或句中，后面通常有逗号隔开，用来补充真实或意外的事实。

senses.en: Representing a calculated middle value, or typical rather than exceptional.
A value calculated by dividing a total by the item count.
Have a particular amount as the usual or calculated middle value.

ex.en: The average price of these jackets is quite reasonable.
ex.zh: 这些夹克的平均价格相当合理。

ex.en: Average household spending on energy may fall as better insulation reduces the need for heating.
ex.zh: 随着更好的隔热措施减少供暖需求，家庭能源支出的平均水平可能下降。

tip: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。

senses.en: Become greater in amount or size, or make something greater
A rise in the amount, size, or level of something

ex.en: The bakery increased its prices again this week.
ex.zh: 这家面包店本周又涨价了。

ex.en: An increase in public transport investment could reduce traffic congestion and improve air quality in cities.
ex.zh: 增加公共交通投资可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。

col: an increase in demand｜需求的增长
tip: 动词重音在后，名词在前；by接增量，to接终值。

senses.en: A hard black or brown material burned to produce heat.

ex.en: The old stove still burns coal during winter.
ex.zh: 这个旧炉子冬天仍然烧煤取暖。

ex.en: Replacing coal with renewable energy can reduce air pollution and lower greenhouse gas emissions from electricity generation.
ex.zh: 用可再生能源替代煤炭，可以减少空气污染并降低发电产生的温室气体排放。

tip: coal指煤，charcoal指木炭；煤通常用作不可数名词。

senses.en: something that makes an event or situation happen
make something happen, especially something unpleasant
an aim or principle that people support and work towards

ex.en: The plumber found the cause of the leak.
ex.zh: 水管工找到了漏水的原因。

ex.en: Heavy traffic is a major cause of air pollution in many rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 在许多快速发展的城市地区，繁忙的交通是空气污染的主要原因。

tip: 名词常接of；动词可用cause sb to do sth。

senses.zh: （bad 的比较级） 更差的；更糟的

senses.en: Less good or more unpleasant, harmful, or serious.
Less well or more badly.

ex.en: The weather grew worse as we climbed the hill.
ex.zh: 我们爬山时，天气变得更糟了。

ex.en: Traffic congestion may become worse unless cities invest in reliable and affordable public transport.
ex.zh: 除非城市投资建设可靠且价格合理的公共交通，否则交通拥堵可能进一步恶化。

tip: bad和badly的比较级；最高级是worst。

senses.en: After a short time from now or another stated time.

ex.en: Dinner will be ready soon, so wash your hands.
ex.zh: 晚饭很快就好了，去洗手吧。

ex.en: Unless cities improve public transport soon, traffic congestion is likely to become increasingly severe.
ex.zh: 除非城市尽快改善公共交通，否则交通拥堵很可能日益严重。

tip: as soon as引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时。

senses.en: friendly wishes or greetings sent to someone, especially at the end of a letter

ex.en: Please give my best regards to your parents at home.
ex.zh: 请代我向家里的父母致以最诚挚的问候。

ex.en: At the end of an email to a pen pal, we can write "Best regards".
ex.zh: 给笔友写邮件结尾时，我们可以写上“谨致问候”。

col: give my regards to｜代我问候
tip: 表示“问候”时一定要用复数regards，常用于书信和邮件结尾。

senses.en: An area around people's homes within a town or city.
The people living in a particular local area.

ex.en: A small bakery has just opened in our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 我们街区刚开了一家小面包店。

ex.en: Investing in neighbourhood parks can improve residents' health while creating opportunities for people to meet and socialise.
ex.zh: 投资建设社区公园可以改善居民健康，同时创造见面和社交的机会。

tip: 英式拼写为neighbourhood，美式为neighborhood。

senses.en: to make structures or develop something over time
the size and shape of a person's body

ex.en: We built a small wooden shelter in the garden.
ex.zh: 我们在花园里搭了一个小木棚。

ex.en: Local authorities should build more affordable homes near public transport to support families on low incomes.
ex.zh: 地方政府应在公共交通设施附近建造更多经济适用住房，以帮助低收入家庭。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为built；体格可用build。

senses.en: To make something smaller or less in amount or degree.

ex.en: We can reduce waste by using our leftovers.
ex.zh: 我们可以利用剩饭剩菜来减少浪费。

ex.en: Governments should invest in renewable energy to reduce carbon emissions and improve long-term energy security.
ex.zh: 政府应投资可再生能源，以减少碳排放并改善长期能源安全。

tip: reduce by接减少量；reduce to接减少后的量。

senses.en: to use something again instead of throwing it away

ex.en: We can reuse empty glass jars to hold our pencils.
ex.zh: 我们可以重复使用空玻璃罐来装铅笔。

ex.en: To protect our planet, students learn how to reuse shopping bags and old paper at school.
ex.zh: 为了保护地球，学生们在学校学习如何重复使用购物袋和旧纸张。

col: reuse plastic bags｜重复使用塑料袋
reduce and reuse｜减少并再利用
tip: 前缀re-表示“再、重新”，re+use就是“再使用”，动词发/z/音。

senses.en: to process used materials so they can be used again

ex.en: We recycle glass bottles at the centre near our house.
ex.zh: 我们把玻璃瓶送到家附近的回收中心回收。

ex.en: Cities can reduce landfill waste by making it easier for residents to recycle everyday packaging.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过方便居民回收日常包装来减少填埋垃圾。

col: recycle household waste｜回收生活垃圾
tip: recycle指回收加工再利用，reuse侧重直接再次使用。

senses.en: A narrow-necked container for liquids, or the amount it holds.
To put a liquid into bottles for storage or sale.

ex.en: She filled her water bottle before leaving the house.
ex.zh: 她出门前把水瓶装满了。

ex.en: Choosing a reusable bottle instead of disposable plastic containers can help reduce waste in cities.
ex.zh: 选择可重复使用的瓶子而非一次性塑料容器，有助于减少城市垃圾。

col: reusable bottle｜可重复使用的瓶子
tip: a bottle of water是一瓶水；water bottle是水瓶。

senses.en: To make something damaged or broken work properly again
Work done to restore something damaged or broken
To improve a damaged relationship or put a situation right

ex.en: Can you repair the broken zip on my jacket?
ex.zh: 你能修好我夹克上坏掉的拉链吗？

ex.en: Encouraging consumers to repair household appliances rather than replace them could significantly reduce electronic waste.
ex.zh: 鼓励消费者维修而非更换家用电器，可以显著减少电子垃圾。

tip: 具体维修常用复数repairs；beyond repair表示无法修复。

senses.en: A single object, especially one in a collection.
One part of a list, programme, or news report.

ex.en: Please place each item carefully in the shopping bag.
ex.zh: 请把每件商品小心地放进购物袋。

ex.en: Each item on the meeting agenda addresses a different challenge facing local public transport services.
ex.zh: 会议议程中的每一项都涉及当地公共交通服务面临的不同挑战。

tip: item是可数名词；一件衣物可说an item of clothing。

senses.en: to put things into groups according to their type or size

ex.en: Let us sort the old books by size on the shelf.
ex.zh: 我们把架子上的旧书按大小分类整理吧。

ex.en: Every day, students in Shenzhen sort waste into different bins to help protect the environment.
ex.zh: 每天，深圳的学生们都会把垃圾分类放进不同的垃圾桶以保护环境。

tip: 作动词指“分类整理”，常用sort...into...；作名词才指“种类”。

senses.en: Material made by weaving or knitting fibres.
A piece of fabric used for cleaning or covering things.

ex.en: She chose soft cotton cloth for the baby's blanket.
ex.zh: 她选了柔软的棉布来做婴儿毯。

ex.en: Replacing disposable wipes with reusable cloth can reduce household waste and lower long-term cleaning costs.
ex.zh: 用可重复使用的布代替一次性湿巾，可以减少家庭垃圾并降低长期清洁成本。

tip: 布料义不可数；抹布可数，复数cloths；勿混clothes。

senses.en: to choose someone or something from available options
to remove fruit or flowers from a plant
a tool with a pointed metal head for breaking hard ground

ex.en: You can pick any colour for your new curtains.
ex.zh: 新窗帘的颜色你可以随便选。

ex.en: Schools should help students pick courses that match their interests rather than focus only on future earnings.
ex.zh: 学校应帮助学生选择符合兴趣的课程，而不是只关注未来收入。

tip: pick可指挑选或采摘；捡起通常用pick up。

senses.en: to lift something from the floor or ground with your hand

ex.en: Please pick up the ruler that fell under your desk.
ex.zh: 请捡起掉在你课桌下面的尺子。

ex.en: During the beach clean-up day, volunteers pick up plastic bottles to keep the ocean clean.
ex.zh: 在海滩清洁日，志愿者们捡起塑料瓶来保持海洋干净。

tip: 接代词it/them时要放中间，如pick it up，不能放末尾。

senses.en: a lightweight manufactured material that can form many different shapes
made of plastic
able to be shaped or changed easily

ex.en: This lunch box is made of strong recycled plastic.
ex.zh: 这个午餐盒由结实的再生塑料制成。

ex.en: Reducing single-use plastic packaging could protect marine ecosystems and lower the costs of managing household waste.
ex.zh: 减少一次性塑料包装可以保护海洋生态系统，并降低生活垃圾处理成本。

tip: 表示塑料材料时通常不可数；a plastic指一种塑料。

senses.en: Use more of something than necessary or without useful results.
Unwanted material left after something has been used or made.
An unnecessary or unproductive use of time, money, or resources.

ex.en: Don't waste water by leaving the tap running.
ex.zh: 别让水龙头一直开着，白白浪费水。

ex.en: Reducing household waste requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of responsible consumption.
ex.zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众的负责任消费意识。

col: a waste of money｜浪费金钱
tip: 用waste time doing sth，通常不用to do。

senses.en: Energy carried by charged particles, used to power devices

ex.en: The storm cut off electricity to our entire street.
ex.zh: 暴风雨导致我们整条街停电了。

ex.en: Generating electricity from renewable sources can reduce dependence on fossil fuels and lower greenhouse gas emissions.
ex.zh: 利用可再生能源发电可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并降低温室气体排放。

tip: electricity不可数；electric多指用电的，electrical指电相关的。

senses.en: a device that controls water flowing from a pipe
to touch or hit something lightly
to use an available source of energy, knowledge, or resources

ex.en: Please turn off the tap while brushing your teeth.
ex.zh: 刷牙时请关上水龙头。

ex.en: Universities can tap local expertise to develop practical solutions to environmental problems affecting nearby communities.
ex.zh: 大学可以利用当地的专业知识，为影响周边社区的环境问题制定切实可行的解决方案。

col: turn off the tap｜关上水龙头
tap someone on the shoulder｜轻拍某人的肩膀
tip: 水龙头在美式英语中常称faucet。

senses.zh: （用刷子）刷净， 刷亮，刷平顺

senses.en: a tool with bristles used for cleaning, painting or arranging hair
to clean, paint or arrange something using a brush
to touch something lightly while moving past it

ex.en: Use a soft brush to clean your muddy shoes.
ex.zh: 用软毛刷清理你沾满泥的鞋子。

ex.en: Children should learn to brush their teeth properly, as good habits can prevent many dental problems.
ex.zh: 儿童应学会正确刷牙，因为良好的习惯可以预防许多牙齿问题。

tip: brush against表示轻擦；brush up on表示温习。

senses.en: a hard structure in the mouth used for biting and chewing
a pointed part of a tool, comb or wheel

ex.en: The dentist checked each tooth with a small mirror.
ex.zh: 牙医用一面小镜子检查了每颗牙齿。

ex.en: Regular dental checkups can help prevent tooth decay and reduce the need for expensive treatment.
ex.zh: 定期牙科检查有助于预防蛀牙，减少接受昂贵治疗的需要。

tip: 复数是不规则形式teeth，注意元音也变化。

senses.en: A container used for rubbish or for storing things.
To throw something away, especially into a rubbish container.

ex.en: Please put the banana skin in the kitchen bin.
ex.zh: 请把香蕉皮放进厨房的垃圾桶。

ex.en: Providing a separate bin for food waste can help households recycle more effectively and reduce landfill use.
ex.zh: 提供单独的厨余垃圾桶有助于家庭更有效地回收废物，并减少垃圾填埋量。

tip: “垃圾桶”英式常说bin，美式常说trash can。

senses.en: To prevent someone or something from being harmed or lost.
To use less of something or keep money for later.
To keep something for future use, especially computer data.

ex.en: The lifeguard saved a child from the deep water.
ex.zh: 救生员从深水中救起了一个孩子。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can save commuters time and reduce household travel costs.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以节省通勤者的时间，并降低家庭出行成本。

tip: save money既可指省钱，也可指存钱。
